title: E-challan recovery
action: Link unpaid challans to licence renewal, vehicle registration transfer and insurance renewal.
tradeoff: Strong lever on payment, but needs reliable data sharing across states and a fair way to contest wrong challans.

title: Repeat-offender licence suspension
action: Suspend the licence after a set number of violations, as the 42-challan example shows is needed.
tradeoff: Directly targets the worst offenders, but risks disputes, livelihood impact for professional drivers and heavier court workload.

title: Camera and tech enforcement
action: Use cameras and automated detection so violations are caught without relying on police presence.
tradeoff: Reduces discretion and bias, but costs money, needs maintenance and raises privacy questions.

title: Awareness and attitude change
action: Run sustained campaigns on right of way, lane discipline and shared responsibility.
tradeoff: Addresses attitudes, but effects are slow and hard to measure, and it fails without enforcement behind it.
